  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Your medicines",
      "bullets": [
        {
          "id": "b1",
          "text": "Furosemide 40 mg, two times a day, for fluid buildup. Swallow it.",
          "sources": ["p1:L11", "term:BID", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b2",
          "text": "Lisinopril 20 mg, once a day in the morning, for high blood pressure. Swallow it. Was 40 mg.",
          "sources": ["p1:L12", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b3",
          "text": "Carvedilol 12.5 mg, two times a day with food, for heart failure. Swallow it.",
          "sources": ["p1:L13", "term:BID", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b4",
          "text": "Clopidogrel 75 mg, once a day in the morning, to prevent blood clots. Swallow it.",
          "sources": ["p1:L14", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b5",
          "text": "Rosuvastatin 40 mg, every night at bedtime, for cholesterol. Swallow it.",
          "sources": ["p1:L15", "term:QHS", "term:PO"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b6",
          "text": "Check Carvedilol dose with your care team before taking it. Record says 25 mg, paper says 12.5 mg.",
          "sources": ["conflict:conflict-2", "p1:L13", "record:32"]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
